skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Under Surgical Lights
skins.content: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Under Surgical Lights. Outfit of the doctor from the Hospital of Horror in the story. With bloodstained bandages and a wrapped-up mannequin, the mad doctor picks up his scalpel, searching for the secrets of the human body beyond ethical reach.
skins.quote: No need to rush to handle the sacrifices the nurse nabbed without a sweat. Once he's done with maintaining the mannequin, his exhilarating and delightful grand experiment shall begin again.
